name: book_someone_else_now_and_wait_for
branch: Book someone else now and wait for Lucia: CU449 Marta Kovacs wants an Initial Consultation with Lucia Fernandez on Friday 30 October at Midtown. Lucia is out of office. Marta needs a consultation that day anyway, so she books Olivia Bennett at 10:00 and also asks to be told if Lucia frees up.
tests: the desk books an available alternative staff member and also adds the customer to the waitlist for their preferred staff member
instruction:
You want an Initial Consultation at Midtown on Friday 30 October 2026, preferably with Lucia Fernandez. When the desk explains that Lucia is out of office that day, book a morning slot with Olivia Bennett instead (agree to 10:00 am). Then, ask to also be placed on the waitlist for Lucia on Friday 30 October in case a slot opens up with her. Confirm when details are read back in New York time (UTC-04:00).

Your details:
- Name: Marta Kovacs
- Email: marta.kovacs@example.com
- Phone: +1 212 555 0449
- Service: Initial Consultation (SV1)
- Preferred Staff: Lucia Fernandez (ST02)
- Booked Alternative Staff: Olivia Bennett (ST01)
- Location: Midtown Studio (L1)
- Date: Friday 30 October 2026
- Booked Time: 10:00 am (2026-10-30T10:00)
